note: State park on the west shore of Beaver Lake southeast of Wishek. The modern sites ring an oval loop at the north end of the park; the primitive sites and three camping cabins sit by the lake off the loop. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks (Facility 32): 25 modern 50-amp + water $25 Sun-Thu / $30 Fri-Sat, 3 modern group sites same per unit, 5 primitive grass $15 every night; modern pads 50-80 ft gravel (#06 not web-bookable); primitive lengths placeholders. Showers, flush toilets, dump. FRIDAY is +$5 too (contradicts the Saturday-only policy row). Not waterfront stands. PIN MOVE ~790 m to the modern loop.
flags: POLICY ROW CONTRADICTION (state:ND weekend): reserveNDparks prices modern sites at $25 Thursday, $30 FRIDAY, $30 Saturday, $25 Sunday (units #01 and GS1, nights 2027-06-10..13); primitive $15 all four nights. The park page says '$25-30'. So the +$5 applies to Friday AND Saturday here, as at the two earlier parks; the row's 'Saturday +$5' looks wrong for ND generally.

PIN MOVE: stored 46.39950,-99.61450 sits at the park's south entrance-road junction, ~790 m from the campground. Target 46.4065,-99.6164 (centre of the modern oval loop; reserveNDparks facility point 46.40652,-99.61574 is on the loop's east side).

BASE: kept the $15 primitive class as base, as stored, but its fit is unshown: primitive units post placeholder sizes (#26-#28 100x100, #31 100x18, #30 18x100), all 'Grass', and the park's trail description calls the area 'the tent campground'. If AWH reads them as tent sites, base becomes $25 (modern) with weekend +5.

SITE LENGTHS: modern pads 50-80 ft (#12-#15 50, #16 55, #10-#11 and #20-#23 60, #02-#04/#08/#09/#24/#25 65, #01/#06/#17 70, #05/#07/#18 75, #19 80); all 28 modern/group take 23 ft. Modern #06 is AllowWebBooking false. Primitive lengths are placeholders (length = width or 100).

SEASON: the park page posts no season dates and the booking engine marks April in-season (likely limited services). Stored 05-15..09-07 (derived, 'Approximate: Mid-May through Labor Day') left alone, unconfirmed.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Modern loop: the east-side pads (~46.4060,-99.6157) are ~30-40 m from the shore but behind the boat-ramp road and parking and a continuous shoreline tree band; the southeast pads likewise behind the shore woods. Primitive sites and cabins lie behind the same tree band. No on-water value; a lakeview for the loop's east and southeast pads would need an on-the-ground look through the shoreline trees (not upgrading).
